en-US.title: Ascend: 75 Hard Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Daily habit & challenge log
en-US.description:
Ascend is your daily companion for the 75 Hard challenge — build discipline one day at a time by tracking the habits that matter, and watch your streak grow.

WHAT YOU CAN TRACK
• Daily workouts (two-a-day support)
• Water intake
• Diet adherence
• Steps (auto-synced from Apple Health)
• Reading
• Progress photos
• Weight
• Mood
• Sleep
• Skincare
• Cycle tracking

BUILT AROUND YOUR CHALLENGE
Set up your own challenge — choose which rules to track, set your goals, and pick your duration. Not doing the strict 75-day version? Customize it to fit whatever challenge you're running.

APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Connect Apple Health once and Ascend automatically pulls in your steps, workouts, sleep, and water intake — no manual double-entry.

STRAVA INTEGRATION
Connect Strava and your workouts sync in with their correct activity type automatically — no more re-entering runs, rides, or lifts by hand.

YOUR DATA, YOUR ICLOUD
Ascend stores your data in your own private iCloud account, not on a company server. Sign in with Apple — no usernames, no passwords, no account to leak. Nobody but you can see your logs, not even us.

STAY MOTIVATED
Track your streak, review weekly and monthly analytics, and earn badges as you hit milestones. See exactly how consistent you've been at a glance.

Ascend is ad-free, doesn't sell your data, and doesn't track you across other apps or websites.
en-US.promoText: Now powered by iCloud — your data stays private in your own account, synced across your devices. Connect Strava for accurate workout types. No ads.
en-US.releaseNotes: 2.0.0 brings a full rebuild on Apple's private iCloud storage — your data now lives in your own iCloud account, synced across devices, with Sign in with Apple replacing email/password. Also new: Strava integration for automatic workout syncing.
